headline: Lieutenant General (retd) Nauman Mahmood, the first secretary general of the Makkah Defence Alliance between Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Turkiye, is expected to take up his responsibilities in Riyadh soon, the Foreign Office said on Friday, Dawn reports.

card.desc: Lt Gen (retd) Nauman Mahmood jald zimmedariyan sambhalenge

caption:
Makkah Defence Alliance ke secretary general jald Riyadh mein zimmedariyan sambhalenge!
Dawn ke mutabiq Foreign Office ne Friday ko bataya ke Lt Gen (retd) Nauman Mahmood jald Riyadh mein apni zimmedariyan sambhalenge. Unhein 23 September ko Pakistan, Saudi Arabia aur Turkiye ke is alliance ka pehla secretary general muqarrar kiya gaya tha.
Aap ke khayal mein yeh alliance kitna ahem hai? Comment mein batayein 👇
